name: superpowers
description: Agentic shipping workflows for Codex: multi-agent orchestration, Codex repo setup, UI/game QA, docs hygiene, image assets, and deployment verification.

interface.shortDescription: Ship polished work with agents, QA, docs, and deploy checks.
interface.longDescription: Superpowers packages a reusable Codex workflow for large autonomous product updates and repo agent setup: read the repo first, split work across agents, create dependency maps, translate Claude Code-style patterns into Codex surfaces, generate visual assets when UI feels weak, add regression tests, update docs and dated logs, and verify deployment before calling work done.
defaultPrompt: Use $agentic-ship to ship this update end to end.
Use $agentic-ship to improve this UI with agents and QA.
Use $agentic-ship to update docs, tests, and deployment.
Use $agentic-ship to apply a Codex agent structure to this repo.
